tes femmes de bien, & honeſtes, le recog
noiſtront: & que ce pendant ladite de
Rols, ores eſtant en la puiſſance. dudit
Pierre Guerre, demeurant en ſa maiſon,
fuſt ſequeſtrée, & miſe en quelque mai-
ſon de gens de bien, ou ne peuſt eſtre ſe-
duite, ni ſubornée. Au reſte, concluant
Si par les vulgaires & communes reigles de droict, il
eſt à grande raiſon defendu ſequeſtrer les biens {a}: c'eſt
à dire les ſeparer de la main & puiſſance du poſſeſſeur,
pour les mettre és mains tierces {b}. parce qu'on ne doit
pas facilement, ni ſans vrgentes raiſon, & cognoiſſance
de cauſe priuer aucun de la poſſeſſion de ſon bien {c}.
A plus forte raiſon, la ſequeſtration & ſeparation des
perſonnes doit eſtre prohibee: meſmement, quand ou
les veult oſter de la compagnie de ceux qui luy appar-
tiennent de bien pres: comme ſont peres, & meres
enfans ou autre prochains parẽs {d}. Et au contraire auſſi,
tout ainſi que quand il y a bonne & ſuffiſante cauſe,
(comme eſt vne crainte que les parties ne viennent
aux armes {e}, & ſoupçon de fuite, ou de poureté {f}.) il eſt
indubitalement permis ſequeſter le bien meuble, &
les fruis de l'immeuble {g}: pareillement aux perſonnes,
ne fault faire difficulté, que quand il y a quelque ſoup
çon, & crainte de ſeduction, ou autre cauſe legitime,
le Iuge ne puiſſe iuſtement proceder à la ſequeſtration
d'vn homme, ou d'vne femme: & la mettre en la cõpa-
gnie de gens de bien, qui la gardent de parler, & con-
uerſer auec perſonnes ſuſpects {h}. Comme par
exemple', ſi le mari demande eſtre reintegré de ſa
femme, laquelle toutesfois iuſtement craint ſon au

uncertain.text: Et que ſes femme, & ſeurs, luy fuſſent
uncertain.note: sic: 'ſes femme' (plural determiner, singular noun), verified at 8x; transcribed as printed. 'fuſſent' checked at 7x: two tall long s (ſſ), not ſs.

uncertain.text: 'accarez: ſ'aſſeurant qu'elles, qui ſont tou
uncertain.note: a faint, thin, comma-shaped mark stands at cap height immediately left of 'accarez', clear of the letter and aligned on the column's left edge. Read as a printed apostrophe/raised comma and kept, but it is markedly lighter than the solid apostrophes of 'ſ'aſſeurant' and 'qu'elles' on the same line, so it could be offset ink or a stray sort: the reconciler should decide. 'ſ'aſſeurant' verified at 7x as ſſ. Line ends 'tou' with no hyphen (continues 'tes').

uncertain.text: Rols, ores eſtant en la puiſſance. dudit
uncertain.note: the mark between 'puiſſance' and 'dudit' is read as a PERIOD: at 8x it is a small compact dot sitting on the baseline, visibly smaller and without the descending tail of the comma after 'bien' three lines below in the same block. The print sets a space before it; normalized per §1. 'puiſſance' verified as ſſ.

uncertain.text: ſon de gens de bien, ou ne peuſt eſtre ſe-
uncertain.note: printed tight as 'debien'; normalized to 'de bien' per §1. The mark after 'bien' is a comma (dot plus a clear tail below the baseline at 8x).

uncertain.text: tes femmes de bien, & honeſtes, le recog
uncertain.note: 'de bien' again set tight; normalized. Line ends 'recog' with no hyphen (continues 'noiſtront').

uncertain.text: à dire les ſeparer de la main & puiſſance du poſſeſſeur,
uncertain.note: 'puiſſance' and 'poſſeſſeur' both checked at 12x: every double s is a pair of tall long s (ſſ), no short round s.

uncertain.text: pour les mettre és mains tierces {b}. parce qu'on ne doit
uncertain.note: the print sets the marker and the stop tight against the next word ('b.parce'); normalized per §1. The stop is a round dot on the baseline (period), checked at 8x.

uncertain.text: de cauſe priuer aucun de la poſſeſſion de ſon bien {c}.
uncertain.note: 'poſſeſſion' checked at 12x: both pairs are ſſ. 'la poſſeſſion' set tight in the print; normalized.

uncertain.text: enfans ou autre prochains parẽs {d}. Et au contraire auſſi,
uncertain.note: 'parẽs': the mark over the e is a thick, nearly horizontal wavy bar at 14x, plainly a tilde and not the thin slanted acute used on 'reintegré' (line 22) — read as parens. 'auſſi' checked at 12x: two tall long s (ſſ), not 'auſsi'.

uncertain.text: ne fault faire difficulté, que quand il y a quelque ſoup
uncertain.note: the print sets a space before the comma ('difficulté ,que'); normalized per §1. Line ends 'ſoup' with no hyphen (continues 'çon').

uncertain.text: d'vn homme, ou d'vne femme: & la mettre en la cõpa-
uncertain.note: mark after 'femme' verified at 8x as two dots (colon). The line-end break sign after 'cõpa' is a short raised blob rather than a clean dash; transcribed as '-' per §1.

uncertain.text: exemple', ſi le mari demande eſtre reintegré de ſa
uncertain.note: a small raised comma-shaped sort stands between 'exemple' and the comma, at ascender height and clearly inked (12x). Transcribed as an apostrophe; its purpose is unclear and it may be a stray sort, so the reconciler should check it.

uncertain.text: femme, laquelle toutesfois iuſtement craint ſon au
uncertain.note: the page ends here mid-word: 'au' has no hyphen and continues on p038. No catchword is printed.

uncertain.text: le Iuge ne puiſſe iuſtement proceder à la ſequeſtration
uncertain.note: 'puiſſe' checked at 12x: ſſ, not ſs.

uncertain.text: l. e. C. de ꝓ-
uncertain.note: the last sort is a p carrying an abbreviation stroke on the descender. At 18x on the raw scan the stroke reads as a bar crossing the descender, which is the form of ꝑ (per/par), but the word continued on the next line is 'hib.', so the abbreviation must be pro: transcribed ꝓ. ESCALATE: a ꝑ/ꝓ decision the reconciler should confirm against a better image.

uncertain.text: hib. ſeq. pec.
uncertain.note: first letter read as h, not b: its bottom right is an open arch, unlike the closed bowl of the b two glyphs later and of the key letter b on the next margin line. Confirmed by the parallel 'ex-' / 'hib.' at the end of margin_notes[7] (= exhib.). Citation resolves to C. de prohibita sequestratione pecuniae.

uncertain.text: c. i. ve lis
uncertain.note: the last word is 'lis' or 'lia': at 14x the third glyph matches the italic round s of 'domus' (margin_notes[3]) better than an a, and 'lis pend.' (= lite pendente) with 'pend.' on the next line makes the reading coherent. Set with a wide gap after 've'; normalized to one space per §1.

uncertain.text: l ſi domus
uncertain.note: 'l' carries no period here (contrast 'l.licet' in margin_notes[1] and 'l.ſi' in margin_notes[5]); transcribed as printed. 'ſi' has no crossbar at 10x, so long s not f.

uncertain.text: P. qui confi
uncertain.note: 'confi' with an fi ligature: the tall sort shows a clear crossbar at 12x, so f not long s (word continues 'tetur' = confitetur). Line ends without a hyphen.

uncertain.text: leg. i l. poſſeſ-
uncertain.note: 'poſſeſ-' checked at 10x: ſſ then a final long ſ before the break sign.

uncertain.text: l. aquiſſi-
uncertain.note: 'aquiſſi-' checked at 12x: both s are tall italic long s with descenders (ſſ), not ſs.

uncertain.text: app. l a. l. ab.
uncertain.note: the isolated tall sort after 'app.' carries no dot and is read as l; at 12x it could also be a b with a very thin bowl. Wide gaps in this line normalized to single spaces per §1.

uncertain.text: l. ijs. P ſi ve
uncertain.note: 'ijs' is printed with two dots over the i and j pair (the usual ij form); transcribed 'ijs'. No period is printed after the P.

uncertain.text: ro v. raque.
uncertain.note: the slanted mark above 'ro' is NOT an accent: at 18x it sits far above x-height and lines up with the descender of the long ſ of 'ſi' on the line above. Transcribed 'ro' without an accent.

uncertain.text: D. de liber. ex-
uncertain.note: the word before the break is an over-inked blot roughly three x-height sorts wide, followed by a faint dash. Read 'ex-' because the next margin line is 'hib.' (D. de liberis exhibendis); the blot could as easily be transcribed 'exx' or 'exe'. ESCALATE: the reconciler should settle this against a better image.

uncertain.text: Si par les vulgaires & communes reigles de droict, il
uncertain.note: validator long-s warning checked against the image: 'Si' opens the annotation with a roman CAPITAL S (not a long s), so the short s is correct here. The word 'ainſi' later in the block does use long s.
